components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single verdigris call to action; pill shape, 44px minimum height, ambient glow.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; padding: 0.6875rem 1.375rem; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; min-height: 2.75rem; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: 0.0125rem; touch-action: manipulation; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s, opacity 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--teal); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 1.25rem var(--teal-dim); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--teal-hover); box-shadow: 0 0 1.75rem var(--teal-glow); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--teal); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet outlined pill for the non-primary action; fills with a teal wash on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; padding: 0.6875rem 1.375rem; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; min-height: 2.75rem; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: 0.0125rem; touch-action: manipulation; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: var(--aged); border: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { color: var(--teal); border-color: var(--teal); background: var(--teal-dim); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--teal); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Inset ink well for search, forms, and typing practice; verdigris border on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.375rem; } .ds-field-label { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--aged); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem; background: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); color: var(--parchment); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.85rem; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--aged); font-style: italic; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--teal); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--teal-dim); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Horizontally scrolling filter pill; active state fills solid verdigris.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: 0.5rem; } .ds-chip { flex-shrink: 0; padding: 0.3125rem 0.875rem; border-radius: 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: transparent; color: var(--aged); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--teal-dim); color: var(--parchment); } .ds-chip-active { background: var(--teal); color: #fff; border-color: var(--teal); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--teal); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Verbum Vitae is a candlelit scribe's study rendered as a phone app. Its material vocabulary is the manuscript workshop: dark leather bindings (#252321), parchment text (#f0ece8), gold leaf for reward, rubric-red ink for correction, and a single working ink of verdigris teal (#1a9b8c) for everything interactive. The metaphor is carried entirely in color, type, and proportion — never in texture images — so the interface reads as a bound devotional book rather than a themed skin.

The mood is warm, reverent, and quietly confident. It is a daily companion, not a monument: surfaces are calm and low-contrast, chrome recedes, and the scripture is the brightest thing on screen. Fraunces, a variable serif with real calligraphic warmth, carries verse text, references, and every meaningful numeral; Nunito, a rounded humanist sans, handles the working UI so labels stay legible at 11px on a phone. Generous 44px touch targets and a 20px corner radius keep the book soft in the hand.

Density is low and pace is unhurried. The layout is a single narrow column (max 32.5rem) that grows into a sidebar layout on desktop without ever becoming a dashboard. Ornament is rationed to one thing: a lone ✦ divider under collection headers, plus the teal drop-cap on a revealed verse. This restraint is deliberate — it is what keeps the system devotional instead of decorative.
keyCharacteristics: Leather-and-parchment tonal layering with 1px borders; flat at rest, glowing only on action.
One interactive accent (verdigris teal); gold, rubric, and sage are semantic states, never decoration.
Fraunces for the sacred text, Nunito for the working interface, tabular mono for numerals.
Pill buttons at 44px minimum, soft 20px radii on every container.
Dark-first, with a fully specified warm light mode that swaps ink and parchment.
Confirmed anti-references: glassmorphism and neon SaaS gradients, literal skeuomorphic texture, heavy gothic ornament, and generic mobile-app chrome.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Verdigris is the only interactive color. Gold, rubric, and sage communicate state and must never be used to make something look tappable. If a control is interactive, it is teal; if it is gold, it is a reward; if it is rubric, it is a warning.

rules.name: The Inked Wash Rule
rules.body: Tinted surfaces use alpha washes of their own color (--teal-dim, --gold-dim, --rubric-dim, --sage-dim), never a lighter solid. Tint means "this state is active", and it should always read as the same plane with ink laid over it.

rules.name: The Sacred Serif Rule
rules.body: Fraunces is reserved for what the user is meant to dwell on — verse text, references, names, and reward numerals. Nunito never sets scripture, and Fraunces never sets a button.

rules.name: The Small Caps Rule
rules.body: Any label under 12px is uppercase with at least 0.06em tracking. Lowercase micro-type is not permitted.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. If something appears to float, it is either an overlay above the page or an accent responding to hover — there is no third reason to add a shadow.

rules.name: The Border-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: To separate two surfaces, add a 1px --border and change the fill, never a shadow. Borders define the book's structure; shadows are reserved for things that leave the page.

dos: Do use verdigris (--teal) for every interactive or active state, and nothing else.
Do separate surfaces with a 1px --border and a tonal fill change (--leather over --ink), not a shadow.
Do set scripture, references, names, and reward numerals in Fraunces; set UI labels and body in Nunito.
Do use --radius (1.25rem) for cards, inputs, and modals, and 9999px for buttons, tabs, and chips.
Do keep every tap target at least 2.75rem (44px) and add touch-action: manipulation.
Do guard every animation with @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce).
Do give focus a visible 2px solid var(--teal) outline (offset 1–2px) wherever the default outline is removed.
Do write every string in warm Brazilian Portuguese with typographic ellipses (…) and curly quotes.
donts: Don't add shadows to cards — --card-shadow is none by design.
Don't use gold, rubric, or sage to make something look tappable; they are states, not actions.
Don't introduce glassmorphism, frosted panels, or neon and purple-blue SaaS gradients.
Don't render literal leather grain, paper texture, faux stitching, or object-mimicking shadows — the material metaphor lives in color and naming only.
Don't use blackletter type, dense filigree, or drop caps anywhere except the revealed verse first-letter and the single ✦ divider.
Don't import Material floating action buttons, stock card shadows, or a corporate-blue accent.
Don't add an English fallback string or a localization layer; the product is PT-BR only.
